contexts.text: He urged them exceedingly () = a state of temptation when [the man] conquers. Explained.
When in this combat the man seems to urge the Lord... to be present, etc.
They pressed upon the man () = that they wanted to offer violence to truth.
He urged him () = ... the affection itself inspired (in it).
The exactors were urgent () = that those infesting most nearly were urgent.
The end, which is the salvation of the human race, being urgent...
The Lord is present in man, and urges the reception of Himself... TCR 766.
